## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 409 captures during January 2026. Activity was completed as part of the routine service, with records submitted for image-quality review and subsequent grading. The volume provides the basis for monitoring throughput and identifying any operational issues affecting delivery.

## Image quality

There were 18 ungradable captures. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 4.4 per cent. The clinic should continue to review image-acquisition practice and ensure that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. This will support follow-up of equipment concerns and help reduce avoidable ungradable results.

## Grading

A total of 105 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 2 days. Grading performance should continue to be monitored alongside activity and image quality, with particular attention to the relationship between ungradable results, equipment issues and referral outcomes. Records should remain complete and available for routine service review.
